references.text: Prohibition against baking grain offerings with yeast - no yeast or honey shall be offered as a fire offering to the Lord
The grain offering is most holy, and only Aaron's sons may eat of it
The sin offering is most holy (קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים)
The guilt offering is most holy (קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים)
The guilt offering shall be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy
The grain offering that remains from the Lord's fire offering is most holy and must be eaten without yeast
The guilt offering belongs to the priest just like the sin offering - it is most holy
The altar is most holy (קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים)
The priests' share of the most holy offerings, including grain offerings, sin offerings, and guilt offerings
